These '''droids''' were anthropomorphic droids that hovered off the ground and could attack with their front arms. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] encountered them on the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] rooftops as he was trying to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|pursue]] an [[Zam Wesell/Legends|attempted assassin]].
